geography.forest_cover_percentage: 62.4% (dominated by Sal, Teak, and mixed deciduous forests)

primary_livelihoods: Minor Forest Produce (MFP) collection (Mahua, Tendu, Tamarind, Sal seeds, Harra, Bahera, Chironji, Lac)
Subsistence agriculture (Kodo, Kutki, Ragi, indigenous rice varieties)
Traditional crafts (Dhokra lost-wax bell metal, Wrought iron / Loha shilp, Terracotta, Bamboo crafts, Kosa silk)
demographics_and_economy.major_trade_hub: Jagdalpur Mandi - recognized as one of the largest tamarind and forest produce aggregation centers in Asia
industrial_nodes: NMDC Steel Limited (NSL) - 3 MTPA integrated steel plant at Nagarnar (16 km from Jagdalpur)
NMDC Bailadila Iron Ore Complex (Kirandul and Bacheli in adjacent Dantewada district)
TRIFOOD Park Jagdalpur (Ministry of Food Processing & TRIFED initiative for MFP value addition)

health: Sickle Cell Anemia carrier rate estimated at 10-15% in indigenous populations across central tribal belts
High seasonal incidence of falciparum malaria and venomous snakebites in forested terrains
Cold-chain maintenance challenges in remote Sub-Health Centres and mobile medical units
water_and_environment: Severe iron contamination (>3.0 mg/L) in borewells across Bastar/Dantewada due to hematitic geology
Seasonal forest fires in March-May triggered by ground leaf-litter burning for Mahua flower gathering
Over 50,000 solar dual drinking water pumps installed by CREDA facing lack of real-time telemetry
post_harvest_losses: Rapid perishability of high-value wild mushrooms (Boda - Termitomyces) within 36 hours
Quality degradation of Mahua flowers due to ground dirt and open-air drying, reducing farmgate prices by 40-50%
Manual tamarind deseeding resulting in high musculoskeletal strain and broken seed contamination
Kodo and Kutki small-millet hulling losses exceeding 35% in conventional rice mills

policy_and_ecosystem.state_policy: Chhattisgarh Innovation and Startup Promotion Policy (2025–30)
policy_and_ecosystem.state_seed_fund: Up to ₹10 Lakhs seed grant for valid Proof-of-Concept (MVP) via Invest Chhattisgarh portal
policy_and_ecosystem.district_mineral_foundation: Bastar District Mineral Foundation (DMF) Trust - earmarks >60% funds for healthcare, drinking water, sanitation, and skill development
national_schemes: DST NIDHI-PRAYAS (up to ₹10 Lakhs prototype grant)
BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG - up to ₹50 Lakhs)
National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission (7 crore targeted screenings)
TRIFED Van Dhan Vikas Yojana (VDVY) & Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs)
MSME Idea Hackathon 3.0 (up to ₹15 Lakhs prototype funding)
